div.div:
Authorities are re-read from the in-memory store on every request: a token subject that is not stored falls back to ROLE_USER, so the diagram-01 JWT (user) can GET /customers but gets 403 on writes. The store also serves HTTP Basic (user · admin).
Sessions are stateless and CSRF is off — the client resends the Bearer header on every request.

div.div: Solid arrows are calls; dashed arrows are returns. The 401 is produced by Spring Security authorization, not by the filter, which always continues the chain.
